subject: One-time Growth Concession for Healthgrit: extended POC + credit uplift
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily.park@healthgrit.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: additional runway & credits for Healthgrit POC

Jonas,

Thanks again for the product demo yesterday — the team is excited. We need one favor to keep momentum: our clinical integration work is taking longer than expected, and the stakeholders have asked for a slightly longer evaluation window plus an uplift in complimentary credits so we can run a full 30-day field trial across three clinics.

Specifically we are requesting:
- Extend the POC from 30 days to 75 days (one-time exception)
- Add $12,000 in complimentary hosted credits for the field workloads (estimated to cover tokens and embedding usage)

We understand this is beyond standard PLG limits. This is a strategic pilot for us — if we hit the KPIs (reduction in clinician documentation time by 20% and stable latency under 350 ms), Healthgrit intends to move to a committed Dedicated cluster within 6 months. Can you escalate for executive approval?

I attached a draft SOW and a metrics spreadsheet for the trial. Happy to hop on a quick call if useful.

Best,
Emily Park
Head of Product, Healthgrit
emily.park@healthgrit.com

Attachments: healthgrit-sow-draft.pdf, field-trial-metrics.xlsx

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: additional runway & credits for Healthgrit POC

Team — forwarding Healthgrit ask. Key points: 75-day runway (one-off), $12k credits. Prospect signals enterprise motion and slow clinical integrations. They explicitly say committed Dedicated within 6 months if KPIs met.

My read: high likelihood of conversion but needs runway. Proposed guardrails for approval flow:
- Approve 75-day extension and $10k in hosted credits today (pre-approved margin), with a follow-up review at day 45 to decide remaining $2k uplift
- Require an MOU or short addendum signed by customer acknowledging trial metrics and commitment to a commercial review at 45/75 days
- CS (Monica) owns the success plan and weekly checkpoints

Can Aditya or Marissa weigh in on margins/precedent? If we get exec signoff we should document the concession in HubSpot and send the addendum+DocuSign link.

Appreciate the context. I spoke with Revenue Ops — here's what I'm willing to approve as a one-time, conditional concession:

- Approved: extend POC to 75 days (one-time).
- Approved: $12,000 total complimentary credits, but disbursed in two tranches: $8,000 up front + $4,000 contingent on hitting the day-45 sync milestones.
- Conditions:
  - Sign the short addendum (sales-opps to draft) that includes the KPIs and the conversion review at day-45 and day-75.
  - Limit: single-seat admin access for Redwood monitoring and weekly usage reports to be shared with us.
  - Credits expire if we do not see weekly checkpoints or the addendum is not signed within 5 business days.

Marissa — please update the HubSpot deal HG-2027-0914 with the concession record and prepare the DocuSign addendum (use the template: "POC-Extension-Concession-v2"). Monica — can you set up the success plan and the 45/75 day checkpoints?

Jonas — once DocuSign is ready, share the link with Emily and confirm start date. Keep this gated behind the signed addendum.

Aditya Rao
Head of Revenue | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
